patient_guardians_identity_chk.name: patient_guardians_identity_chk
patient_guardians_identity_chk.value: "patient_guardians"."guardian_patient_id" is not null or "patient_guardians"."guardian_name" is not null

patients_document_bidx_uq.name: patients_document_bidx_uq
patients_document_bidx_uq.where: "patients"."document_number_bidx" is not null and "patients"."deleted_at" is null

services_deposit_required_chk.name: services_deposit_required_chk
services_deposit_required_chk.value: not "services"."deposit_required" or "services"."deposit_cents" is not null or "services"."deposit_bps" is not null

waitlist_entries_time_window_chk.name: waitlist_entries_time_window_chk
waitlist_entries_time_window_chk.value: "waitlist_entries"."preferred_time_from" is null or "waitlist_entries"."preferred_time_to" is null or "waitlist_entries"."preferred_time_from" < "waitlist_entries"."preferred_time_to"
